dialog.speaker: boss
dialog.tr: Sen devam et, ben sadece bakıyorum. Yok say beni.
dialog.en: Carry on, I'm only watching. Pretend I'm not here.

dialog.speaker: boss
dialog.tr: O hücreyi sola al. Biraz daha. Şimdi geri al. Bence ilk hâli daha iyiydi.
dialog.en: Move that cell left. Bit more. Now undo it. I think the first version was better.

dialog.speaker: boss
dialog.en: May I have the keyboard for one second?

choices.en: Say 'I'll show you when it's done'

ver.tr: Klavyeyi verdin. Yirmi dakika sonra tablo bitti; sen kendi sandalyenin yanında ayakta duruyordun.
ver.en: You handed it over. Twenty minutes later the spreadsheet was finished. You were standing next to your own chair.

coach.en: The spreadsheet is done. She still has the chair.

anlat.tr: Her tıklamayı anlattın. Nevin Hanım her cümleye 'hı hı' dedi ve kırk dakika kaldı. İş normalde on beş dakikalıktı.
anlat.en: You narrated every click. Ms. Carver said 'mm-hm' to each one and stayed forty minutes. It was a fifteen-minute job.

coach.tr: On beş dakikalık iş, kırk dakikalık anlatım.
coach.en: A fifteen-minute job. With forty minutes of commentary.

sonra.tr: 'Bitince göstereyim' dedin. 'Tabii, tabii' dedi ve gitti. Bitmiş hâline tek düzeltme geldi: bir hücre sola.
sonra.en: You said you'd show her when it was done. 'Of course, of course.' She left. The finished version came back with one edit: a cell moved left.

sonra.tr: 'Bitince göstereyim' dedin. 'Tabii' dedi ve bir sandalye çekip yanına oturdu.
sonra.en: You said you'd show her when it was done. 'Of course,' she said, and pulled up a chair.

coach.en: There are now two chairs at the desk.

wager.reason: check'siz ya da düşük riskli gün

intent.setup: patronun masana gelip omzunun üstünden tabloyu canlı düzelttirmesi
